notes.title: Koei, developers of PC strategy series Romance of the Three Kingdoms, did most of the work on the new Fire Emblem
notes.content:
Koei Tecmo is well-known for a few things: Team Ninja's Dead or Alive and Ninja Gaiden, Omega Force's Dynasty Warriors series and its many spin-offs, and most recently, the Dark Souls-inspired Nioh. But most famous, at least in Japan, is its long-running series of strategy games based on Romance of the the Three Kingdoms, which debuted on Japanese PCs in 1985(!). It turns out that same development team that makes Romance has recently been busy with a different strategy series, doing most of the work for Nintendo on its newest Fire Emblem game for the Switch.

"Intelligent Systems provided Koei Tecmo with a minimum crew of several designers, a music composer, and an adviser to the programmers... we then left Koei Tecmo in charge of basic game development," said director Toshiyuki Kusakihara (Intelligent Systems is the studio behind Fire Emblem and Advance Wars).

In a Famitsu interview translated by Nintendo Everything, Kusakihara said that the Romance of the Three Kingdoms team were "well-renowned" for making strategy RPGs. "They're the best of the best," he said, and it was only after Intelligent Systems decided to give the Romance team the project that they "considered their sense of world-building with three balanced kingdoms." That's how Fire Emblem: Three Houses came to be.

It seems safe to say that the new Fire Emblem's structure would have turned out quite differently without Koei Tecmo's involvement. And taken longer to finish, according to the interview. Judging by overwhelmingly positive reviews of Fire Emblem: Three Houses, which note how effectively it changes up the Fire Emblem formula, the partnership paid off.

Sadly we can't play the new Fire Emblem on PC, though as Tom points out, it'd make for a great PC series. But if the Fire Emblem buzz has you curious, you can play Romance of the Three Kingdoms on PC. While many of the older games in the series were only released in the west on the PlayStation, Romance of the Three Kingdoms 13 is available on Steam.

Thanks, Resetera

notes.title: Update Information Ver.1.0.4.0 （3/3/2016）
notes.content:
■ Added/Changed Functions
・Added a selection allowing the conclusion of an alliance as a Force Council assignment.
　When the assignment involves making an alliance, the Ruler will act in a relevant manner.
・Added a Suppl line controls (Manual/Auto/Auto Redistribution) to the system settings.
・Added the ability to narrow down a list based on which Units and officers are in Control Battles.
・Added events where the player character encounters officers or merchants when moving. 
・Added a process allowing officers to be unjured during duels or when their units are wiped out. 
・Adjusted the routine governing when the player character is a prisoner.
・Added a routine issuing a penalty when money for duties has been used up.

■Adjusted/Improved game balance
・Adjusted so that players can attend the Force Council after becoming rank 2 or higher. 
・Adjusted the trigger conditions for coalitions.
・Adjusted conditions for cities that can issue a Protection Petition or conditions for attempts.
・Adjusted a condition where the supplies of new Forces was insufficient so they could not deploy upon starting a new game. 
・Adjusted strategy  algorithms 
　①Overall brush up of the defense related algorithm.
　②Added a supply line algorithm making it more difficult for supplies to run out. 
　③Added an algorithm for Rulers to buy specialty items, give specialty items to subordinated and so on.
　④Adjusted so that an envoy is sent when the Force Assignment is Forming an Alliance.
　⑤Adjusted so that is more difficult to move an officer immediately after he is hired.
Etc.
・Adjusted algorithms in Control Battles.
　①Improved the field battle algorithms.
　②Improved the siege algorithms.
　③Improved the defense algorithms.
　④Improved the unit retreat algorithm.
　⑤Adjusted the response upon being attacked with a fire tactic.
Etc.
・Adjusted destructive power of higher troop types and siege weapons.
・Adjusted other balance issues.

■Bug Fixes
・Fixed a bug that allowed tactics to be freely used when restarting a control battle.
・Fixed a bug that played a male voice though the main character was female.
・Fixed so that the event "Moving to Xu/Liu Bei Stands" can trigger even when Lu Bu is Dong Zhuo's subordinate.
・Added certain of the Spouse settings that had been left out.
・Adjusted the initial settings for Han Hao in a number of settings.
・Fixed some other bugs.
